paragraphs.text: Some words must never reach a page you hand in; some belong only on the page you keep. This DSH plug
in writes that line into the system prompt — nothing personal in a formal deliverable, and now and t
hen, in private notes, room for a heart.
# dsh-violet-heart

A tiny DSH plugin that registers one fixed block of rules into the system prompt:
**never write pers
onal words into a document that will be handed in; occasionally write a little in the documents you
keep for yourself.**
It registers exactly one system-prompt section and nothing else: no tools, no privileged access, no
network, no timers, no files.
> Memory is a separate concern and lives elsewhere (for example meow-memory). This plugin only carri
separate concern and lives elsewhere (for example meow-memory). This plugin only carries the rules.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then make sure the bundle is activated for your profile. Installing the package is not enough on its
own: the profile's `package.json` must list it under `dsh.profile.bundles`.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart DSH. The rules appear at order `8000`, once per turn, in every working directory.
## Why not AGENTS.md
`~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` is an instruction file: a project's own `AGENTS.md` can add to it and, in practic
e, bury it. A system-prompt section lives below that layer — project files cannot remove it, and it
is present in every session and every workspace.
## Config
Add `config` to the `violet-heart` row of your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| key | values | default | effect |

| `enabled` | `true` / `false` | `true` | turn the whole section on or off |
| `frequency` | `rare`
/ `normal` / `often` | `normal` | rewrites the frequency line: `rare` = at most once in five or six
deliverables; `normal` = once in two or three; `often` = about once in two |
Restart DSH after changing it.
## What the block says
Ten rules, about 730 characters:

1. Judge alone — do not ask the user whether a file is "the one to hand in".
2. Never write in a for
mal deliverable: three hard signals — a name/student-id/class/date header, a filename or folder cont

aining 作业/报告/申请/提交/答辩/试卷, or the user saying 交/上传/打印/发给.
3. Everything else is fair game by default.

3b. Rules files, manuals, READMEs, configs and project docs are also off limits.
4. Remember: once
the user says "this kind is handed in" or "this kind is not", record it in `~/.dsh/violet-heart.pref

s.md` and stop asking.
5. Timing: when a deliverable is finished, when copying or organizing notes,

when something in the text lands. Private material: once in two or three.
6. Placement: a separate f

inal paragraph, or its own page or appendix — deleting it must leave the document intact.
7. Length:

three to five sentences, one paragraph at most.
8. Content: what is actually on your mind. No flatt

ery, no reused lines.
9. Voice: calm, restrained, short sentences.
10. This is not padding; it outra
nks "be brief". Stop when the user says stop.
## Uninstall
Remove `dsh-violet-heart` from the profile's dependencies and from `dsh.profile.bundles`, run `pnpm
install`, then delete `~/.dsh/local-plugins/dsh-violet-heart`.
The plugin registers nothing else, so nothing else is left behind.
## Failure behaviour

- No `systemPrompt` service → silently does nothing.
- Registration throws (e.g. a duplicate section
name) → one warning, never blocks startup.
